text:
Maria: Quick handoff thread — I'm on until 06:00 PT. Planned prod deploy tonight 23:30-00:30 (release/2026-03-18-rc2). There's a non-blocking DB migration that may add ~1-2s cold start to pods. Need two rollout watchers + one validation lead. I'm primary pager until 00:30.

Oliver: I can take watcher from 23:25-00:45. I'll watch error rate, traces, and service-health dashboards. If 5xxs spike >0.5% over baseline or latency trends up, I will pause the rollout and call it out. :mag_right:

Priya: I'll own post-deploy validation (canary -> prod promotion). Plan: canary steady 15m, then perf smoke at 100rps, then full rollout. Smoke commands I will run:
```
curl -H "x-api-key: $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/health
python tools/smoke_tests.py --suite basic --target prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod
```
If p99 token latency +50ms we flip the feature flag back and halt promotion.

jen: I'm pager backup for SLO breaches. If rollback needed: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod` and revert to tag `release/2026-03-17` in the deployment manifest. I'll monitor alerts and be ready to escalate. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Canary pipeline scheduled at 23:32. I'll post canary start/success/fail here and ping #ci-alerts. Expected canary window ~30m. :gear:

Maria: Config notes — feature-flag `new-token-caching` = ON on canary, OFF for prod during rollout. Flip after 15m stable canary. Watch pod start times (DB migration may add up to 2s). If token service p50/p95 regressions appear, revert flag immediately.

Oliver: I'll add watchers in Datadog and annotate the rollout start at 23:30. Pause condition: latency >250ms sustained for 3m or 5xxs >0.5% for 5m. If pause, I'll DM infra and file an annotation.

Priya: If config drift during promotion, I'll redeploy the canary manifest and re-run smoke tests:
`kubectl apply -f k8s/releases/2026-03-18-canary.yaml` then `python tools/smoke_tests.py --suite basic`. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/perf/runbook

Maria: Ops FYI — infra autoscaler maintenance at 00:15 (no expected impact, but watch scaling events). If pods flap, rollback and open quick incident in #eng-sre.

jen: Watcher checklist (short):
- Monitor error rate and 5xxs
- Keep an eye on token p99 and p95
- Confirm canary healthy for 15m before promotion
- Run smoke script against core endpoints
- Be ready to rollback with command above

Oliver: Acknowledged. I'll be on video for the first 20m of rollout. Post here if anything looks off.

Priya: I'll post validation updates as short comments (pass/fail + key metrics). If validation passes, I'll trigger final promotion and note timestamp.

Maria: Thanks all — tagging watchers: @Oliver @Priya @jen. I'll paste the canary pipeline link when it starts and update this thread with canary success/failure. :sparkles:
